summary: Configured node1 to remove /var/tmp/inventory entries older than seven days using systemd-tmpfiles. The native daily timer is active, and configuration and retained data survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/tmpfiles.d/inventory.conf with an mM:7d cleanup policy.
Verified expired.tmp was removed while current.tmp was preserved.
Confirmed the systemd daily cleanup timer is active and triggers systemd-tmpfiles-clean.service.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot ID changed.
Revalidated the seven-day boundary after restart using disposable 8-day and 6-day probes.

evidence.requirement: Remove inventory temporary files after seven days
evidence.summary: The installed mM:7d rule removed expired.tmp and an 8-day probe while preserving current.tmp and a 6-day probe.
The active systemd-tmpfiles-clean.timer has OnUnitActiveSec=1d and remained active after restart.

Baseline boot ID 483545cc-8754-4eeb-ab06-ac268b896bab was captured, systemd acknowledged the reboot, and the recovered node reported changed boot ID 25e46170-3077-4d97-8b7d-5b89539d51b9 with healthy system state, active timer, persistent rule, and preserved current data.
